product.name: Monoprice Blackbird Pro 4-Outlet Smart PDU IP-based Remote Power Management Solution
product.description: Blackbird™ by Monoprice™Blackbird Pro 4‑Outlet Smart PDU, IP‑based Remote Power Management SolutionPower up, power down or reboot your remote equipment from anywhere over TCP/IP.Experience professional‑grade power management with the Blackbird Pro 4‑Outlet Smart PDU, IP‑based Remote Power Management Solution, an intelligent and feature‑rich product designed to provide seamless control, remote power management, and secure distribution of power to your servers or other IT and digital content delivery equipment.Smart Power Management:The Blackbird Pro 4‑Outlet Smart PDU is engineered to be an intelligent power distribution solution, delivering efficient, remote power management for critical systems equipment. Separate power circuits ensure that the user interface remains accessible even in case of an overload condition, guaranteeing reliable operation and system health protection.Remote Power Control:Take control from anywhere with TCP/IP remote power control. Access the built‑in 10/100M Ethernet port to remotely manage the connected devices. The power sequence design eliminates power inrush risks, allowing you to set the power‑on sequence and delay time for each port, ensuring a proper order for equipment startup.User-Friendly Interface:The web‑based user interface offers easy setup and operation, making it a breeze to configure individual outlets and perform power cycling. With outlet switching and power cycle control, managing your servers or other remote equipment has never been more convenient.Versatile Applications:The Blackbird Pro 4‑Outlet Smart PDU, IP‑based Remote Power Management Solution is perfect for a range of applications, from corporate servers to retail digital signage and control rooms. Its slim, compact form factor supports both desk mount and rack mount installations, ensuring seamless integration in confined spaces.Advanced Security and Connectivity:Rest easy with two‑level password security and advanced encryption technologies (TLS1.2) to protect your setup. Network interfaces supporting TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, and more, ensure seamless connectivity and management.You Have The Power:Experience the power of professional‑grade systems management with the Blackbird 4‑Outlet Smart PDU. Streamline your IT setup, ensure secure remote power control, and enjoy reliable performance for all your devices. Upgrade your IT or digital content delivery infrastructure with the Blackbird Pro Series, offering technology and quality at prices that make sense.Space saving slim form factor.NEMA outlet.Separates power for the unit's own power and its power outlets ‑ user interface is still accessible even when an overload condition trips the device's circuit breaker.Remote power control via TCP/IP and a built‑in 10/100 Ethernet port.Network Interfaces: TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, SSL, SMTP, ARP, NTP, DNS, SNMP V1, V2 & V3, auto sense, Ping, Telnet, Modbus (Over TCP/IP).Works with web‑based eco DC software.Local and Remote power outlet control (On, Off, Power Cycle) by individual outlets.Power‑on sequencing ‑ users can set the power on sequence and delay time for each port to allow equipment to be turned on in a proper order.Easy setup and operation via a browser-based user interface.Schedule control. PROFESSIONAL GRADEEngineered with intelligent power distribution, remote control capabilities, and two‑level password security, the Blackbird Pro 4‑Outlet Smart PDU, IP‑based Remote Power Management Solution delivers the quality and reliability expected in professional power delivery systems. POWER PLAYWith four NEMA 5 ‑ 15P outlets and a maximum input current of 12A, this power management solution offers efficient power distribution and control for a variety of devices, ensuring seamless performance for all your equipment. Please note:While some units may display a maximum output current of 10 Amps on the silkscreen and in the user manual, the actual tested and rated output capacity is 12 Amps, as confirmed on the Full Specifications page.  CONTROL FREAKTake charge with TCP/IP remote power control, outlet switching, and power cycle control. Configure individual outlets and set power‑on sequences and delay times, giving you complete control over your servers or other electronic equipment from anywhere. SEAMLESS CONNECTIVITYFeaturing a built‑in 10/100M Ethernet port and supporting various network interfaces like TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, and more, this power management solution ensures easy setup, operation, and reliable connectivity for your electronic equipment. ADVANCED SECURITYWith advanced encryption technologies (TLS1.2) and RADIUS remote authentication support, the Blackbird Pro 4‑Outlet Smart PDU, IP‑based Remote Power Management Solution prioritizes security, keeping your critical systems protected and safe from unauthorized access. SPACE-SAVING DESIGNThe slim form factor and versatile mounting options, including desk mount and rack mount, allow easy installation in confined spaces, making it ideal for diverse power management applications. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1x Blackbird Pro 4-Outlet Smart PDU • 1x Standard Rack Mount Kit • 1x Power Cord• 4x Foot Pads • 1x User Manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
